chunk_title: Core Magnetism & Psychological Drivers Across All 6 Archetypes

sections.title: Core Psychological Drivers & Magnetism Engines
bullets: The Dolphin operates on an Affiliative Magnetism engine driven by relational harmony, deep empathy, and communal belonging, drawing people in through warmth and unconditional social inclusion [DP-1].

The Fox operates on a Tactical Magnetism engine driven by autonomy, unconventional agility, and rapid problem-solving, attracting others through cleverness, wit, and unpredictable adaptability [DP-2].

The Lion operates on an Authoritative Magnetism engine driven by outcome mastery, high status, and decisive command, capturing attention through unflinching confidence and goal-oriented dominance [DP-3].

The Owl operates on an Intellectual Magnetism engine driven by rational clarity, systemic precision, and deep discernment, commanding respect through intense, deliberate analysis and objective wisdom [DP-4].

The Peacock operates on an Expressive Magnetism engine driven by recognition, theatrical passion, and high social optimism, commanding the center of attention through contagious enthusiasm and vibrant drama [DP-5].

The Bear operates on a Grounded Anchor Magnetism engine driven by protective stability, emotional containment, and unshakeable calm, making others feel profoundly secure in high-stress environments [DP-6].

The Wolf operates on an Intuitive Guardian Magnetism engine driven by pack loyalty, perceptive vigilance, and instinct-led authority, exerting magnetic pull through quiet mystery and fierce fidelity [DP-7].
